project.name: KHKD - Bo Ngua
project.description: Vietnamese science-horror Reel — bo ngua cai an dau con duc khi giao phoi
project.story: Praying mantis sexual cannibalism: during mating the larger female often turns and bites off the smaller male's head. Remarkably, the decapitated male's body keeps mating with even greater vigor, because removing the head removes inhibitory brain control over the mating reflex. The male's body becomes nutrients that nourish the female's eggs. About a quarter of matings end this way.
